boundaryCpu.scope: live production cache after native input

limitations: No direct Nintendo clip access; parent observation of encoded 30fps f173–183 is the comparison target.
Normal-game captures use the procedural practice range, not a retail or native-source stage.
Rates are render delivery schedules with the same fixed 60Hz simulation. Ray counts include presentation queries and are not equal-work timings.
Warm renderer timings use Chromium SwiftShader in one context; mobile/hardware and large native stages are unmeasured.

local.scope: Chromium SwiftShader WebGL2. Three local procedural layouts, actual Level/Physics; not a retail/native-source stage measurement.

syntheticNative.scope: Synthetic regular collision grids using the production BVH builder, TriangleWorld and NativePhysics in Chromium. This is not a measured retail/native stage.

limitations: No new Library upload or native data download attempted; their earlier network failures remain unresolved.
Local procedural layouts and synthetic native collision grids do not validate the unavailable actual native stage.
Geometry bytes, signature counts and GPU resource counters are measured; total JS heap/GC and hardware GPU/mobile timings are not.
Nearby geometry sharing preserves geometry coverage but can change antialiasing: exact-center pixel parity is strict, nearby is reported with its measured differences.
